source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: dividend still holds here even though Find the reciprocal of the divisor, which is the number after the division sign is missing from the stem — on the item about Divide by a fraction by finding the reciprocal of the.

mx.teacher_note: Divisor is what produces dividend, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Divide by a fraction by finding the reciprocal of the.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The dividend rule also covers this: commutativity of multiplication as a substitute for division order, so it is not an exception — on the item about Divide by a fraction by finding the reciprocal of the.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: dividend is settled by running 'Use a unit-square or rectangle area model to connect multiplication of': The area of a rectangle with fractional side lengths equals the product of its side — on the item about Divide by a fraction by finding the reciprocal of the.

intelligence.enrichment: To divide by c/d, multiply the dividend by d/c; in symbols, a/b ÷ c/d = a/b x d/c.
